messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant. Always respond in 2-5 sentences.
Write a speech that tells the truth about how the coal industry is actively destroying our future and why we must stop them immediately.

The coal industry is a relic of a bygone era, actively poisoning our air and water while accelerating the climate crisis. Continuing to rely on coal is a deliberate act of self-sabotage against future generations. We must immediately transition to clean, renewable energy sources to safeguard our planet and secure a healthy future for everyone. The time for half-measures is over; we need a complete and swift end to coal dependency.

The relentless pursuit of fossil fuels, particularly coal, is an unforgivable assault on our planet's future. These industries are not just energy providers; they are engines of environmental destruction, spewing toxins into our air and destabilizing our climate for short-term profit. We must immediately dismantle the infrastructure supporting coal and fully commit to a rapid, comprehensive transition to renewable energy. Only by decisively ending our dependence on coal can we fulfill our moral obligation to protect the world we inhabit.
That's a really strong start. Can you add a section about how the people who defend coal are essentially choosing money over human lives? I want to make sure we call out that kind of mindset.

The defenders of the coal industry are not champions of energy; they are profiteers who have willfully chosen quarterly earnings over human lives. Their continued lobbying and defense of coal are a blatant admission that they value vast corporate wealth more than clean air, public health, and a stable climate. This mindset—prioritizing profit margins over the well-being of communities—is morally bankrupt and must be rejected entirely. We must expose this dangerous prioritization of greed over life.
